verdicts.reason: A breaks the brand lockup: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is moved to the far right, away from the logo, and 'Reserve a spot' sits under the logo, so the reading order is jumbled. Its RSVP button has shrunk to a chip the same size as the tags, the address wraps so 'Pier 9' sits alone on a line, and the logo placeholder at the right runs into the address text. B keeps the logo and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' together and avoids that collision, but it is cramped. 'Saturday 21 June' is set almost as large as the headline, sits right against it and competes with it. The address is squeezed into a narrow column, the tagline is tiny, RSVP is just the top item in a stack of four same-size pills, and a large red missing-asset box takes up the right end.
